minimal_mechanism.all_rows: Stable candidate_id=(source repository, original ledger index/ref); bind original/head/current observation separately, not branch-name guesses. Preserve all original refs/worktrees and source/evidence history.
minimal_mechanism.modern_framework_candidates: For 11 original framework and framework portions of 35 original mixed candidates, inspect/deduplicate actual changed paths/hunks. Reuse existing current-export ancestry only when exact old-to-new/tree/path evidence covers that contribution; otherwise plan an isolated exact normalized framework recovery snapshot or filtered history, and a neutral standalone refs/recovery/fn258/candidate-NNN ref. Do not import whole monorepo commits into standalone or merge candidates into active main merely to preserve them.
minimal_mechanism.snapshot_qualification: A normalized snapshot can be recovery-only: record every source/destination path, mode/blob, selected/excluded hunk, source original ref/head, receiver commit/tree/ref and verifier. Full authored source history still remains under original Temporal refs. A snapshot does not claim exported commit-history preservation, feature completion or accepted active code. If authored candidate history itself is required in receiver, use a separate isolated filtered-history proof.
minimal_mechanism.source_only_candidates: 26 original Temporal/server/tracker and 9 original legacy candidates can receive explicit source-only retained dispositions with exact existing source recovery refs, repository, tracker links and prerequisites. No standalone copy is needed for unrelated server, archived Scala, obsolete Go checker or tracker records. Experimental/unknown ownership decisions remain frozen until explicitly approved.
minimal_mechanism.tracker_authority: Keep authoritative historical/current Flow descriptors and statuses in Temporal. Each disposition points to exact existing source task IDs/paths and their hashes plus migration fn258.5 for disposition work; do not copy .flow wholesale into standalone or manufacture historical owners. Existing done tasks remain done observations; carried/open successor obligations remain open.
minimal_mechanism.unknown_owner_policy: 15 direct trailer candidates can gain corroborated links; two gain descriptor-qualified links; two gain tracker/migration-scope links; one is an upstream reference; six retain unresolved product-task freezes. Creating a migration tracking record for a freeze does not turn it into an accepted transfer.
minimal_mechanism.dirty_recovery: Current ledger names dirty root assembly, fn2469 baseline, fn254 source assembly, fn2553 fuzz and standalone preparation. Inventory current tracked/untracked/unique ignored inputs with mode/hash and verified external archives/bundles/index/patches; no branch ref alone covers dirty bytes.
minimal_mechanism.standalone_boundary: Keep all metadata and cross-repository tracker links in Temporal artifacts. Neutral standalone ref names only; no system-named files or wholesale tracker/monorepo trees in standalone active source. Any future checked-out recovery candidate must pass normal boundary/adaptation review before activation.
minimal_mechanism.newer_refs: Reconcile seven newer preparation entries and any additional live refs in the overlay. Existing standalone baseline/portable refs are real recovery for their own preparation only, not proof all 81 originals transferred.
minimal_mechanism.prerequisites: Carry the task6 historical prerequisites as provenance; validation-hold was historical, not a current no-execution gate. Current R5 exact pair, destination access/history/publication permission, CI pin activation, separate source-removal authorization, archive/cache preservation and unresolved fn246/fn253/fn254/fn255/fn256/backends obligations need individual current dispositions.

complete_per_candidate_disposition: Explicit reviewed destination category: framework recovery-only, already represented with exact evidence, or source-only retained/frozen experiment approved as a retention decision.
Actual verified receiving ref for relevant framework work, or actual retained source recovery ref for source-only work; all source snapshots/history and dirty recovery remain reconstructible.
Exhaustive selected/excluded/mixed path-hunk accounting, with inherited assemblies deduplicated and no guessed semantic integration.
Authoritative tracker IDs/paths and open successor obligations, actual prerequisite state/proof links, and recorded unresolved product decisions frozen.
Independent verifier passes coverage/object/tree/hash/backup/tracker/prerequisite checks; reviewer explicitly accepts disposition.
completion_rules.not_required_for_migration_disposition: Implementing every deferred feature or merging experimental candidates into standalone main. Accepted recovery/retention and open obligations can satisfy preservation disposition without product acceptance.
completion_rules.not_complete: A proposed ref, empty receiver list, guessed owner, unknown decision silently accepted, snapshot-only preservation mislabeled full history, stale flags, unverified dirty backup or archival of an open obligation without tracker authority.
completion_rules.overall_R6_still_open: Even complete local candidate dispositions cannot satisfy destination inspection/publication, fetchable CI pin, authorized consumer integration/source cutover and post-cutover proof while SSO/access/publication remain blocked.
